checks: Draft and review retain the current event and perform no Nakka or worksheet writes
Confirm creates exactly the reviewed event then delegates selection to the existing LIVE archive/switch service
A lost creation reply remains unresolved until inspected; resolving reads the existing event and never posts again
Event settings mismatch or multiple matching dates prevent selection and retain the original creation record
Stale review, changed sign-in, queued registrations, linked form and invalid settings stop before creation
New arrivals after creation are retained; opening the created event requires the explicit Continue action
Interrupted switch resumes only the matching existing switch journal; no second event is created
The real LIVE archive projection leaves the old snapshot intact and empties only the new event registrations
scope: Focused local event-creation fixtures using the existing LIVE format parser and archive projection; no remote operations.
